name: org.accreditednow/accreditednow
title: AccreditedNow
description: CPA-signed accredited investor verification: prices, documents, order links and sponsor API tools.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current AccreditedNow prices for CPA-signed accredited investor verification letters (individual, joint, self-directed IRA, entities), CPA net worth statements and CPA income letters, plus add-ons, sponsor seat pricing and turnaround. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: What an investor needs to upload for a given product: the documents for each way to qualify (income, net worth or license) and the photo ID rule. No API key needed.

tools.name: get_turnaround
tools.description: How long a CPA-signed verification takes (standard and rush) and how long the letter is valid. No API key needed.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Returns the AccreditedNow order page link for a product, for the person to open and pay on our site. Nothing is bought or created by this call. Use product "sponsor" for a fund or sponsor buying verifications for its investors, or "api" to get API keys. No API key needed.

tools.name: create_verification
tools.description: Create an accredited investor verification for one of your investors and get the investor's secure link (POST /v1/verifications). Without confirm:true this only returns a preview of what would be sent. Partner-paid verifications use your firm's seats. For one person; use the REST API directly for joint or entity verifications. Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

email.description: The investor's email address (required). Their secure link goes here when send_invite is true.

first_name.description: Optional. The investor's legal first name, as it should appear on the letter.

last_name.description: Optional. The investor's legal last name.

phone.description: Optional. 10 to 15 digits, for example +1 317 555 0100. Ignored if not a valid number.

city.description: Optional. City of residence, printed on the letter. Ignored if not a plain place name.

state.description: Optional. US state of residence: 2-letter code (IN) or full name (Indiana). Ignored if not a US state.

billing.description: partner = your seats; investor = the investor pays at checkout. Default is your key's setting.

qualification.description: Optional. How the investor expects to qualify: income ($200,000 individual or $300,000 joint in each of the last two years), net_worth (over $1,000,000 excluding the home) or license (Series 7, 65 or 82). On a partner-paid streamlined link it preselects that path for the investor.

deal.description: Optional deal or fund name for your records.

fund_id.description: Optional. One of your fund ids (from GET /v1/funds) to file this investor under.

external_id.description: Optional. Your own id for this investor (up to 100 letters, digits and . _ : @ -), returned on every result and webhook.

send_invite.description: Have AccreditedNow email the investor their link (partner-paid only).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying so it is created only once.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually create it.

tools.name: get_verification
tools.description: Status and details of one of your verifications (GET /v1/verifications/{id}). Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

id.description: The verification id from create_verification or list_verifications (starts rec, or ver_test_ in the sandbox).

tools.name: list_verifications
tools.description: List your firm's verifications, newest first (GET /v1/verifications). Filter by status, external_id or fund_id. Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

status.description: One of created, in_review, verified, declined, expired, refunded.

external_id.description: Optional. Only the verification(s) with this id of yours.

fund_id.description: Optional. Only verifications filed under this fund id.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging. Default 0.

tools.name: get_letter_link
tools.description: A short-lived download link for the CPA-signed letter on one of your verifications, when the investor agreed to share it (GET /v1/verifications/{id}/letter). Full-access keys only. Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

id.description: The verification id whose signed letter you want (starts rec, or ver_test_ in the sandbox).

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Your firm's recent verification and screening events, newest first, kept 30 days (GET /v1/events). Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

since.description: ISO date-time; only events after it.

limit.description: How many events to return, 1 to 100.

tools.name: screen_person
tools.description: Screen a person against sanctions and PEP lists and add them to your firm's monitored list (POST /v1/screenings). No CPA letter. Counts toward your monitoring plan. Without confirm:true this only returns a preview. Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

first_name.description: The person's first name, as on their ID.

last_name.description: The person's last name, as on their ID.

external_id.description: Optional. Your own id for this person (up to 64 letters, digits and . _ : @ -).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same value when retrying so the person is added only once.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually add the person.

tools.name: list_screenings
tools.description: People on your firm's monitored list and their screening results (GET /v1/screenings). Needs an AccreditedNow API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_... or sk_test_...); get one free at https://accreditednow.org/get-api-access.

limit.description: How many people to return, 1 to 100.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging. Default 0.
